$description: Theme registry. 'appearance' picks which scale values apply; 'extends' inherits semantic overrides. Set data-faun-theme on any element; themes nest.

light.label: Light
light.description: Default. Warm paper surfaces on a warm gray canvas, deep moss green navigation.

dark.label: Dark
dark.description: Green-black canvas with lifted surfaces and highlight edges.

light-hc.label: Light high contrast
light-hc.description: Darker text and borders, no shadows. For low vision and bright rooms.

dark-hc.label: Dark high contrast
dark-hc.description: Brighter text and borders on a deeper canvas.

print.label: Print
print.description: White page, no shadows. Regulatory exports and PDF.
